የኢንቨስትመንት ፈቃድ

አዲሱ አባል የሕግ ሰውነት ያለው አካል ከሆነ የዚሁ አዲስ አባል የመመስረቻ ጽሁፍና የመተዳደሪያ ደንብ ዋና ቅጅ፣ የመቋቋሚያ የምስክር ወረቀት ወይም ተመሳሳይ ሰነድ እና አዲስ በሚቋቋመው ማህበር ውስጥ ለመግባት ሥልጣን ባለው የማህበሩ አካል መወሰኑን የሚያሳይ አግባብነት ባለው የኢትዮጵያ ሰነድ አረጋጋጭ የተረጋገጠ ቃለ-ጉባዔ ወይም ደብዳቤ እና ማህበሩ የውጭ ሀገር ከሆነ የኢንቨስትመንት ፈቃድ እና አክሲዮን እንዲገዛ በሚኒስቴሩ የተሰጠ ፈቃድ
የንግድ ሥራ ፈቃድ ማሻሻያ የተጠየቀበት የስራ መደብ ቀደም ብለው በነበሩት ውስጥ ያልተካተተእናየብቃትማረጋገጫየሚያስፈልገውከሆነ ከሚመለከተውየሴክተር መስሪያ ቤት የተሰጠ የብቃት ማረጋገጫ የምስክር ወረቀት

services.name: Amendment of Trade Name for Business Associations / Corporations
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: The unapproved draft minutes of the general assembly meeting (Minutes of Meeting), duly signed by all members/shareholders.

services.name: Commercial Registration Certificate for Sole Proprietors (Individual Traders)
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Two recent passport-sized photographs taken within the last six months, clearly showing the applicant's identity.
The original and copies of the relevant pages of the applicant's renewed National ID card or valid passport.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.

For Foreign Nationals: In addition to the requirements listed above, a valid Investment Permit must be submitted. If opening a branch office, an official verification of the branch's business address is also required.

services.name: Commercial Registration Certificate for Partnerships and Private Limited Companies (PLC)
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: The original and copies of the relevant pages of the General Manager's renewed National ID card or valid passport.
Two recent passport-sized photographs of the General Manager taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
Original copies of the company's Memorandum of Association, authenticated by a legally authorized document authentication registration agency.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.
An official bank letter confirming the deposited capital held in a closed bank account under the company's temporary name.
If the applicant is a Foreign National: A valid Investment Permit issued by the relevant government authority and the individual's renewed passport.
If a member/shareholder in the Partnership or PLC is a Foreign Legal Entity (Foreign Corporate Body):
Legal registration/incorporation certificate from the country of origin verifying its legal personality.
Legally authenticated minutes of meeting, resolution letter, or equivalent document from the home country expressing the decision to invest and participate in the newly established company.
A valid Investment Permit.

In the case of In-Kind (Asset) Capital Contributions: A signed declaration by the applicant confirming that ownership of the contributed asset will be fully transferred to the partnership or PLC within one budget year from the date commercial registration is finalized.

services.name: Commercial Registration Certificate for One-Member Private Limited Companies (Single-Member PLC)
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: The original and copies of the relevant pages of the General Manager's renewed National ID card or valid passport.
Two recent passport-sized photographs of the General Manager taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
Original copies of the company's Unilateral Declaration (Establishment Statement), authenticated by a legally authorized document authentication registration agency.
An official bank letter confirming the deposited capital held in a closed bank account under the company's temporary name.
A third-party property custodian/trustee affidavit, authenticated by a legally authorized document authentication registration agency.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.

services.name: Commercial Registration Certificate for Share Companies (S.C.)
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: The original and copies of the relevant pages of the General Manager's renewed National ID card or valid passport.
Two recent passport-sized photographs of the General Manager taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
The company's Memorandum of Association, authenticated by the Document Authentication and Registration Agency.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.
An official bank letter/statement confirming that at least one-quarter (25%) of the subscribed shares/capital has been paid up and deposited in a closed bank account.
If there is an individual foreign national member in the Share Company: A valid Investment Permit issued by the relevant authority and copies of their passport.
If a shareholder in the Share Company is a Foreign Legal Entity (Foreign Corporate Body):
Legal registration/incorporation certificate from the country of origin verifying its legal personality.

Minutes of the meeting or an equivalent resolution document showing the decision to invest in the newly forming Share Company, authenticated both under the laws of the home country and by the Ethiopian Document Authentication and Registration Agency.
A valid Investment Permit.

In the case of Intellectual Property (In-Kind) Capital Contributions: Minutes of the meeting or a corresponding document evaluating and accepting the contribution, authenticated by the Document Authentication and Registration Agency.

services.name: Commercial Registration Certificate for State-Owned Enterprises (SOE)
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: The establishment law (regulation/decree) under which the enterprise was founded.
The official appointment/assignment letter of the General Manager.
The General Manager's renewed National ID card or valid passport.
Two recent passport-sized photographs of the General Manager taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.

services.name: Special Commercial Registration Certificate for Commercial Agents / Representatives
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: The Commercial Agent’s/Representative's renewed National ID card or valid passport.
Two recent passport-sized photographs of the Commercial Agent/Representative taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
Official certificate/document proving the legal personality and registration of the principal merchant (the appointing company) in its country of establishment or operation.

An official bank confirmation letter verifying that at least 100,000 USD (One Hundred Thousand US Dollars) has been deposited into a domestic bank account in the name of the representative for the budget year’s salaries and operational expenses.

The official Power of Attorney or appointment letter designating the individual as a representative by the principal merchant, legally authenticated by the Document Authentication and Registration Agency.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.

services.name: Commercial Registration Certificate for Foreign Companies Awarded International Tenders
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: The General Manager's valid passport.
Two recent passport-sized photographs of the General Manager taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
An official Certificate of Incorporation (or equivalent document) verifying the legal personality of the parent foreign company.

Legally authenticated minutes of meeting, board resolution, or an equivalent document proving the parent company's decision to open a branch office in Ethiopia and officially assign the designated General Manager.
The formal tender award agreement/contract from the contracting entity, along with an official letter of support requesting the registration of the company.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.

services.name: Commercial Registration Certificate for Sectorial Associations
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Two recent passport-sized photographs of the General Manager taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
The General Manager's renewed National ID card or valid passport.
The Articles of Association (Bylaws) of the association, legally authenticated by the Document Authentication and Registration Agency.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.

services.name: Commercial Registration Certificate for Branches of Foreign Chambers of Commerce
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Formal written confirmation or clearance permitting the registration, issued by the home country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, their respective embassy, the parent chamber of commerce, or any other relevant government authority.
An official Certificate of Incorporation (or equivalent legal document) verifying the legal personality of the chamber of commerce in its country of establishment.
The official appointment letter designating the General Manager assigned to the newly established branch office by the parent chamber of commerce.
Two recent passport-sized photographs of the branch General Manager taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Certificate.

services.name: Amending a Business Registration Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Photograph: A passport-sized photograph of the manager, taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
Identification: The manager's renewed (valid) ID or passport.
Minutes of the Meeting (For Share Companies/LLCs):
If the amendment is being made to the company’s Memorandum and Articles of Association, the original copy of the authenticated minutes of the meeting where the members approved the amendment.
If the amendment involves capital or a change of address, the original copy of the authenticated minutes of the meeting deciding on the amendment, along with proof of the new address.
Investment Permit: An investment permit is required if a foreign national is joining an existing business share company/partnership as an individual.
Requirements for Corporate Members: If the entity joining the existing business organization as a member is another company/business organization, the following must be provided:
The original copy of its Memorandum and Articles of Association.
A certificate of legal personality (Certificate of Incorporation) or a similar document.
A resolution passed by the authorized body of the company, demonstrating approval to join the newly formed/existing business organization, authenticated by the relevant Ethiopian authority.

services.name: Replacement of a Business Registration Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: If damaged: The original, damaged Business Registration Certificate.
If lost: A police report or official evidence of loss issued by the relevant authority.

services.name: Cancellation of a Business Registration Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: For Business Organizations (Companies/Partnerships): The original copy of the company's dissolution/cancellation minutes of the meeting and an audit report.
Notice of Cancellation: Proof of a public notice published in a newspaper with nationwide circulation, maintained for a period of one month at the applicant's expense.

services.name: Business License Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Identification: The original and photocopies of the relevant pages of the manager's or agent's renewed (valid) ID or valid passport.
Photograph: A passport-sized photograph of the company manager, taken within the last six months, clearly showing their identity.
Memorandum of Association: The company's Memorandum of Association, authenticated by the legally authorized body for document registration.
For Foreign Individuals: If the applicant is a foreign national, a valid passport and an investment permit confirmation issued by the relevant government body.
For Foreign Corporate Members (in Partnerships or Limited Liability Companies): If a foreign legal entity (company) is a member of the business organization, the following are required:
A document certifying its legal personality (incorporation) from its country of origin.
A minute of the meeting or a similar document, authenticated by a legally authorized body, showing the resolution to join the business organization.
An investment permit

services.name: Renewal of a Business License Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Tax Clearance: A tax clearance certificate issued by the relevant authority.
Audit Report: An audit report, if the applicant is a business organization (company/partnership).

services.name: Renewal of a Special Commercial Representative Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Tax Clearance: A tax clearance certificate issued by the relevant authority.

Bank Confirmation: A confirmation letter issued by a bank proving that 100,000 (one hundred thousand) USD has been remitted into the country under the representative's name during the fiscal year of renewal.

services.name: Amending a Business License Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Original Certificate: The current Business License Certificate.
Minutes of the Meeting (For Companies/Partnerships):
If the amendment is made to the company's Memorandum and Articles of Association, the original copy of the authenticated minutes of the meeting where the members approved the amendment.
If the amendment involves capital, additional verification proving the capital adjustment.
If it is a change of address, the original copy of the authenticated minutes of the meeting deciding on the amendment, along with proof of the new address.
Investment Permit for Individuals: The investment permit, if a foreign national is joining an existing business organization as an individual.
Requirements for Corporate Members: If the new member joining the business organization is a legal entity (company), the following must be provided:
The original copy of its Memorandum and Articles of Association, Certificate of Incorporation (Establishment), or a similar document.

A minute of the meeting or an official letter authenticated by the relevant Ethiopian document authentication authority, demonstrating that the authorized body of the company has decided to join the organization.
If the joining company is a foreign entity, its investment permit and the explicit permission issued by the Ministry allowing it to purchase shares.

Certificate of Competence: A Certificate of Competence issued by the relevant sector office/ministry, if the requested business license amendment includes a new business activity/field that was not previously registered and requires professional competence validation.

services.name: Replacement of a Business License Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: If damaged: The original, damaged Business Registration Certificate.
If lost: A police report or official evidence of loss issued by the relevant authority.
If the certificate past its regular renewal period: A tax clearance certificate issued by the relevant authority.

services.name: Cancellation of a Business License Certificate
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
required_documents: Tax Clearance: A specific tax clearance certificate issued for the purpose of business license cancellation.
Trade Name Certificate: The original Trade Name Registration Certificate that was obtained alongside the business license.

services.name: የንግድ ማህበራት የንግድ ድርጅት ስም ስለማስመዝገብ
services.institution_name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration

የንግድ ድርጅት ስሙን እንዲያጸድቅ የተመረጠው የአንድ አባልየታደሰ መታወቂያካርድ ወይም ፓስፖርት ዋናውን እና አስፈላጊ ገፆች ፎቶ ኮፒ
ልፀደቀ የመመስረቻ ፅሁፍ እና የመተዳደሪያ ደንብ
ለድርጅታቸው መጠሪያ የመረጡት ሶስት አማራጭ ስሞች፡፡

services.name: የንግድ ማህበራት የድርጅት ስም ስለማሻሻል

required_documents: በአባላቶቹ የተፈረመ ረቂቅ ያልፀደቀ ቃለ ጉባዬ

services.name: የውክልና ጽህፈት አገልግሎት
required_documents: ጠቅላላ ውክልና፤ ልዩ ውክልና፤ የአስተዳደር ውክልና፤ የሕግ (የጠበቃ) ውክልና
የወካዩን ብሔራዊ መታወቂያ
በብሔራዊ መታወቂያው ላይ የተመዘገበውን ስልክ ቁጥር እና የጠበቃውን የፈቃድ ቁጥር ከሙሉ አድራሻቸው ጋር
በውክልና ከሆነ ማለትም ውክልናውን ለሦስተኛ ወገን ማስተላለፍ ከተፈለገ፣ ትክክለኛው የውክልና ሰነድ መቅረብ አለበት።

services.name: Power of Attorney Drafting Service
required_documents: General Power of Attorney
Special Power of Attorney
Administrative Power of Attorney
Legal (Attorney) Power of Attorney
Required Documents
National ID of the principal (person granting the power of attorney)
The phone number registered on the National ID, and the lawyer's license number along with their full address
If the power of attorney is being delegated (i.e., if the authority is being transferred to a third party), the original legally valid power of attorney document must be presented.

services.name: Sales Contract Writing Service
required_documents: For Vehicle
Required Documents
Vehicle ownership certificate (Libre)
National (Fayda) ID of both the buyer and the seller
Legal document proving the seller's authority to sell (derived from law or contract)
If the asset belongs to a business entity: Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, principal business registration, and minutes of resolutions as necessary
The seller's single/unmarried certificate, or if married, a marriage certificate and spousal consent agreement
Vehicle valuation estimation obtained from the Transport Authority
For Residential Houses
Required Documents

TIN: A valid Taxpayer Identification Number certificate.

Police Clearance Certificate: A fingerprint-verified report issued by the relevant police authority confirming the applicant has no prior record of criminal acts, such as breach of trust, theft, fraud, or related offenses.

services.name: Issuance of Referral Permits for Medical Treatment Abroad / Organ Transplantation
required_documents: A comprehensive medical board recommendation document that is not older than six months.
National ID card of the caregiver/escort, and the National ID, Kebele ID, Ethiopian Passport, or Birth Certificate (for minors under 18 who do not have a National ID) of the patient.
For patients under the age of 18, a parent or legally appointed guardian must accompany them as the caregiver/escort.
A bank-certified document proving a minimum balance of 500,000 ETB in the account.

services.name: አዲስ የመድኃኒትና የህክምና መሳሪያ አስመጪና አከፋፋይ ድርጅቶች የብቃት ማረጋገጫ መስጠት (ኦንላይን እና በአካል)
required_documents: በባለስልጣኑ በተዘጋጀው ቅጽ መሰረት በኤሌክትሮኒክ የቁጥጥር መረጃ ስርዓት (https://ilicense.efda.gov.et) የሚከተሉትን ዋና ቅጂ ሰነዶች እና ማመልከቻውን መልቶ ማቅረብ
የአገልግሎት ክፍያ የከፈለበትን ደረሰኝ ማቅረብ

በመድኃኒት እና በህክምና መሣሪያ ንግድ ድርጅት የሚሰራ ባለሙያን በተመለከተ በኢትዮጵያ የምግብ እና መደሀኒት ባለስልጣን መመሪያ ቁጥር 872/2014 (የመድኃኒት እና የህክምና መሳሪያ አስመጪ፣ ላኪ እና ጅምላ አከፋፋይ ድርጅቶች ቁጥጥር መመሪያ) አንቀጽ 13 ላይ በተቀመጠ መስፈርት መሰረት ሆኖ የቴክኒካል ኃላፊ እና የማከማቻ ክፍል ኃላፊ የትምህርት ማስረጃ፤ የስራ ቅጥር ስምምነት ውል፤ ይሰራበት ከነበረ ድርጅት የተሰጠ እና የለቀቀ መሆኑን የሚገልፅ የስራ ልምድ ደብዳቤ፤ የሙያ ፈቃድ ሰርተፊኬት
በውልና ማስረጃ የተረጋገጠ የቤት ኪራይ ውል ወይም የቤት ካርታ ወይም የይዞታ ማረጋገጫ/ወይም የመንግስት ቤቶች፣ የእምነት ተቋማት ሲሆን ከነዚህ እና ሌሎች ህጋዊ ሰውነት የተሰጣቸው አካላት ጋር የመፈጸም ውል ተቀባይነት
ኃላፊነቱ የግል ማህበር ሲሆን በውል እና ማስረጃ የተረጋገጠ የመመስረቻ ፅሑፍ እና መተዳደርያ ደንብ ወይም ከንግድ ቢሮ ወይም ከሚመለከተው የመንግስት አካል የተረጋገጠ የመመስረቻ ፅሑፍ እና መተዳደርያ ደንብ (ሰነዱ በአንድ ላይ ሊሆን ይችላል)

services.name: የመድኃኒትና የህክምና መሳሪያ አስመጪና አከፋፋይ ድርጅቶች ተጨማሪ መጋዘን
required_documents: በባለስልጣኑ በተዘጋጀው ቅጽ መሰረት በኤሌክትሮኒክ የቁጥጥር መረጃ ስርዓት (https://ilicense.efda.gov.et) የሚከተሉትን ዋና ቅጂ ሰነዶች እና ማመልከቻውን መልቶ ማቅረብ
የአገልግሎት ክፍያ መክፈል

በመድኃኒት እና በህክምና መሣሪያ ንግድ ድርጅት የሚሰራ ባለሙያን በተመለከተ በኢትዮጵያ የምግብ እና መደሀኒት ባለስልጣን መመሪያ ቁጥር 872/2014(የመድኃኒት እና የህክምና መሳሪያ አስመጪ፣ ላኪ እና ጅምላ አከፋፋይ ድርጅቶች ቁጥጥር መመሪያ) አንቀጽ 13 ላይ በተቀመጠ መስፈርት መሰረት ሆኖ የቴክኒካል ኃላፊ እና የማከማቻ ክፍል ኃላፊ የትምህርት ማስረጃ፤ የስራ ቅጥር ስምምነት ውል፤ ይሰራበት ከነበረ ድርጅት የተሰጠ እና የለቀቀ መሆኑን የሚገልፅ የስራ ልምድ ደብዳቤ፤ የሙያ ፈቃድ ሰርተፊኬት
በውልና ማስረጃ የተረጋገጠ የቤት ኪራይ ውል ወይም የቤት ካርታ ወይም የይዞታ ማረጋገጫ/ወይም የመንግስት ቤቶች፣ የእምነት ተቋማት ሲሆን ከነዚህ እና ሌሎች ህጋዊ ሰውነት የተሰጣቸው አካላት ጋር የመፈጸም ውል ተቀባይነት
ኃላፊነቱ የግል ማህበር ሲሆን በውል እና ማስረጃ የተረጋገጠ የመመስረቻ ፅሑፍ እና መተዳደርያ ደንብ ወይም ከንግድ ቢሮ ወይም ከሚመለከተው የመንግስት አካል የተረጋገጠ የመመስረቻ ፅሑፍ እና መተዳደርያ ደንብ (ሰነዱ በአንድ ላይ ሊሆን ይችላል)
ስለ ተቋሙ ሁኔታና አስፈላጊ ግብአቶችን በተመለከተ በኢትዮጵያ የምግብ እና መደሀኒት ባለስልጣን መመሪያ ቁጥር 872/2014 (የመድኃኒት እና የህክምና መሳሪያ አስመጪ፣ ላኪ እና ጅምላ አከፋፋይ ድርጅቶች ቁጥጥር መመሪያ) አንቀጽ 11 እና 12 በተቀመጠው መስፈርት ሆኖ
የማከማቻ ክፍል፤ (ወጥ የሆነ የማከማቻ ክፍል ወይም ጎንለጎን ሆኖው በግድግዳ የተያያዙ ሁለት ክፍሎች ከ40 ካሬ ሜትር ያላነሰ)
የመረካከቢያ ቦታ
የቴክኒክ ኃላፊ ቢሮ
የእጅ መታጠቢያና ዉሃ ያለው መጸዳጃ ክፍል
የተበላሹ ወይም የመጠቀሚያ ጊዜያቸው ያለፈባቸው ወይም በባለ ንብረቱ ፍላጎት ከገበያ የወጡ ወይም ተመላሽ የተደረጉ ወይም ከገበያ የተሰበሰቡ መድኃኒቶች ወይም የሕክምና መሣሪያዎች የሚቀመጡበት የማከማቻ ክፍል
በባለስልጣኑ በተዘጋጀው ቅጽ መሰረት በኤሌክትሮኒክ የቁጥጥር መረጃ ስርዓት ላይ መሙላት

services.name: Change /variation of organization license
required_documents: Receipt of paid service fee

As per the form prescribed by the Authority, complete the application and attached the following original documents online through electronic regulatory information system (https://www.ilicense.efda.gov.et)
Previous certificate of competence
One Passport size photo of the technical manager

In case the applicant is Private Limited Company (PLC), establishment document and administrative regulation attested by Document Authentication and registration Agency or authenticated establishment document and administrative regulation from Trade office or any concerned Government office.
services.fee_text: 500 ETB for technical manager/store manager change and organization name change 750 ETB for owner name change, organization address change, product type category

services.name: Return for Medicine and Medical Device Import, and Wholesale license
required_documents: letter of declaration that describes status of organization and products available, previously issued certificate of competence and application letter
Without prejudice to letter of declaration and application letter any person shall return when:-
Confirmed that products that are expired or damaged are disposed
Confirmed that products decided to recall are recalled
Confirmed that unsold or unused products have been transferred to another institution in accordance with the law

services.name: Certificate of competence replacement for Medicine and Medical Device Import, and Wholesale
required_documents: Receipt of paid service fee

As per the form prescribed by the Authority, complete the application and attached the following original documents online through electronic regulatory information system (https://www.ilicense.efda.gov.et)
If the certificate of competence is damaged, when the applicant returns it
If certificate of competence is lost or burnt, when the applicant has provided proof of evidence from justice organ
One Passport size photo of the technical manager

services.name: Additional warehouse for Medicine and Medical Device Import, and Wholesale
required_documents: Receipt of paid service fee

As per the form prescribed by the Authority, complete the application and attached the following original documents online through electronic regulatory information system (https://www.ilicense.efda.gov.et)
Educational evidences of store manager for additional store
Employment agreement or contract and new store manager for additional store
Working experience letter of additional store manager from the employer that describes his/her resignation
Professional license of additional store manager

House rent contract or official/legal housing plan ( የቤትካርታ) or lease hold title certificate authenticated by Document Authentication and Registration Agency for additional store. For government houses, supporting letters from this organization will be acceptable. Moreover, any agreement between Religious houses and other entities that have legal rights and grounds to rent houses are acceptable. For partially completed building, provide authorization for use of the building for service from responsible body

services.name: Fayda ID Registration
required_documents: Document-Based Registration for Ethiopian Citizens
Acceptable forms of identification include:
Kebele ID
Driving License
Passport
Educational Certificate (Diploma/Degree)
Bank Passbook, etc.
Document-Based Registration for Foreign Nationals
Acceptable identity documents include:
Yellow Card (Origin ID)
Residence Permit
Refugee ID.
Work Permit.
Diplomatic ID.
Employment ID from an International Organization.
Witness-Based Registration (For Ethiopian Citizens Only)
The applicant must bring an eligible witness who already possesses a Fayda Unique/Registration Number.
Registration for Minors (Under 16 Years) and Persons with Intellectual Disabilities or Developmental Delays
Since these applicants cannot legally sign the consent confirmation form, the form must be filled out and signed by their parents or legal guardians.
During registration, the parent or legal guardian must be physically present, bringing their own valid identity document alongside their Fayda Unique/Registration Number.

services.name: Fayda Demographic and Biometric Data Update / Renewal
required_documents: For Name Corrections/Changes
A court decree or official court decision.
For Date of Birth Changes
Birth Certificate
Kebele ID
Passport
Driving License
A court decision confirming the correct date of birth.
For Nationality Changes
From Foreign Nationality to Ethiopian Nationality:
Certificate of Naturalization.
From Ethiopian Nationality to Foreign Nationality:
A Work Permit and Foreign Passport.
A Diplomatic ID (proving deployment to Ethiopia) and Foreign Passport.
An International Organization ID (proving assignment in Ethiopia) or Foreign Passport.
An Ethiopian Origin ID (Yellow Card) and Passport.
For Address Changes
Kebele ID
Bank Passbook (explicitly listing the client's address)
Residential Lease Agreement
Driving License
Project ID
Work/Employee ID
School ID
Health Insurance ID
Productive Safety Net Programme (PSNP) ID
Tax Identification Number (TIN) Certificate
Utility Bill (e.g., water or electricity bill registered under the individual's name)
For Phone Number, Photograph, and Email Updates

ዲግሪውን ለመማር በመግቢያነት የተያዘው ዲፕሎማ ከሆነ እና ዲግሪውን በተማረበት ዘመን የደረጃ 4 ብቃት ማረጋገጫ ሰርተፊኬት ለዲግሪ መግቢያነት የሚያስፈልግ ከሆነ የ ደረጃ 4 COC በተገኘበት ክልል/ከተማ መስተዳድር በሚገኝ የሙያ ብቃት ምዘና ማዕከል የተረጋገጠ ወይም የማረጋገጫ ደብዳቤ ያለው
የዲግሪ መግቢያው ከውጭ የተገኘ የትምህርት ማስረጃ ከሆነ ከባለስልጣኑ የተገኘ የአቻ ግመታ ደብዳቤ እና
የስም ለውጥ ካለ የስም ለውጥ የሚያሳይ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ የተላፈበት ማስረጃ የስም ለውጥ ከተደረገበት የትምህርት ማስረጃ ጋር ተያይዞ መቅረብ አለበት።
በጀርባው ላይ የኮሌጁ ኃላፊና ሬጅስትራር ፊርማና ማህተም ያለበት የሁለተኛ ዲግሪ ሰርተፍኬት እና ትራንስክሪፕት/Student Copy/ ተሟልተው መቅረብ ይኖርባቸዋል።

services.name: Authentication of a Local Bachelor's (First) Degree
required_documents: National ID Number.
Degree Certificate and Transcript (Student Copy): Must be verified on the back with the signature and stamp of the college head (President or Dean) and the Registrar.
Admission Document: The original Diploma and Student Copy, OR the Grade 12 Completion Certificate used to gain admission to the degree program.
If a Grade 12 certificate was used for admission: It must be verified by the Educational Assessment and Examinations Service (EAES).
Note: To verify your Grade 12 certificate, use the official website services.eaes.gov.et to request an official transcript.
If a Diploma was used for admission:
It must be verified on the back with the signature and stamp of the institution's top official (President or Dean) and the Registrar where you studied.
It must also be verified by the regional Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Agency or the Zone/City Job and Training Bureau where the school is located.

If a Level 4 Certificate (COC) was required: If a Level 4 Certificate of Occupational Competency was required for degree entry during your year of study, the Level 4 COC must be verified by the Occupational Competency Assessment Center in the respective region/city administration, or you must provide an official verification letter.
If a foreign educational document was used for admission: An equivalence evaluation letter issued by the Authority.
In case of a name change: If you have legally changed your name, the official court decision document must be submitted along with the educational document.

services.name: Authentication a Local Master's (Second) Degree
required_documents: National ID Number.
Bachelor's (First) Degree Certificate and Transcript (Student Copy): Must be verified on the back with the signature and stamp of the college head (President or Dean) and the Registrar.
Admission Document (for the first degree): The original Diploma and Student Copy, OR the Grade 12 Completion Certificate.
If a Grade 12 certificate was used: Must be verified by the Educational Assessment and Examinations Service (EAES) via services.eaes.gov.et.
If a Diploma was used: Must be verified on the back by the school’s top official (President/Dean) and Registrar, and also verified by the regional TVET Agency or Zone/City Job and Training Bureau.
If a Level 4 Certificate (COC) was required: Must be verified by the regional/city Occupational Competency Assessment Center or supported by a verification letter.
If a foreign document was used for entry: An equivalence evaluation letter issued by the Authority.
In case of a name change: Submit the official court decision along with the educational document.
Master's (Second) Degree Certificate and Transcript (Student Copy): Must be submitted in full, verified on the back with the signature and stamp of the college head and Registrar.

በብሔራዊ ክልላዊ መንግስት በዞን እና ወረዳ ደረጃ የተሰጡ ሰነዶች በቅድሚያ በክልሉ ፍትህ ቢሮ ወይም በክልሉ የሰነድ ማረጋገጫና ምዝገባ አገልግሎት የተረጋገጡ መሆን አለባቸው።
መታወቂያ/ፓስፖርት፣ በወኪል ከሆነ የውክልና ሥልጣን ማስረጃ

services.name: የንግድ ፈቃድና ንግድ ነክ ሰነድች ማረጋገጥ
required_documents: በንግድና ቀጠና ትስስር ሚኒስቴር የተሰጠ የንግድ ፈቃድ ምዝገባና እድሳት ሰነዶችን የማረጋገጥ በቅድሚያ የወቅቱን ግብር የከፈሉ ለመሆኑ ማስረጃ መቅረብ ይኖርበታል

የውጪ ንግድ (Export) እና የገቢ ንግድ (Import) የሚመለከቱ ሰነዶች ከሆኑ በቅድሚያ በንግድና ቀጠና ትስስር ሚኒስቴር ወይም በኢትዮጵያ ንግድና ዘርፍ ማህበራት ምክር ቤት ወይም እንደአግባቡ በክልልና በከተማ አስተዳደር (አዲስ አበባ እና ድሬዳዋ) የተሰጡ ከሆነ በክሌለ ወይም በከተማ መስተዳደሩ ንግድ ምክር ቤት ወይም ንግድ ቢሮ የተረጋገጡ መሆን አለባቸው
ወደ ውጭ የሚላኩ ምርቶች የጤና ኳራንቲንና የመሳሰለትን የሚመለከቱ ሰነዶች ከሆኑ በግብርና ሚኒስቴር ወይም ስልጣን በተሰጣቸው በስሩ በሚገኙ ቅርንጫፍ ጽ/ቤቶች በቅድሚያ የተረጋገጡ መሆን ይኖርባቸዋል፣ በክልላዊ መንግስት የተለያዩ እርከኖች የተሰጡ ከሆነ በቅድሚያ በክልሉ ንግድ ቢሮ መረጋገጥ አለባቸው
ከአዲስ አበባና ድሬዳዋ ከተማ አስተዳደር የተሰጡ ከሆነ በቅድሚያ በአስተዳደሩ ንግድ ቢሮ ወይም በየክፍለ ከተማ የንግድ ቅ/ጽ/ቤቶች የተረጋገጡ መሆን አለባቸው
መታወቂያ/ፓስፖርት፣ በወኪሌ ከሆነ የውክልና ሥልጣን ማስረጃ

services.name: የኢንቨስትመንት ፈቃድ እና ኢንቨስትመንት ነክ ሰነዶች ማረጋገጥ

ከአዲስ አበባና ድሬዳዋ ከተማ አስተዳደር የተሰጡ ከሆነ በከተማ አስተዳደሩ ኢንቨስትመንት ቢሮ በቅድሚያ መረጋገጥ አለባቸው
ከክልላዊ መንግስት የተለያዩ እርከኖች የተሰጡ ሰነዶች ከሆኑ በክልሉ ኢንቨስትመንት ቢሮ በቅድሚያ የተረጋገጡ መሆን ይኖርባቸዋል

services.name: ከዋናው ቅጅ ጋር አብሮ የቀረበ ህጋዊ ማስረጃ ትርጉም ሰነድ ማረጋገጥ
required_documents: በአዲስ አበባ እና ድሬዳዋ ከተማ አስተዳደር የተለያዩ ቦታዎች በሚገኙ ተርጓሚዎች የተተረጏሙ ሰነዶች ከሆኑ በቅድሚያ በሰነዶች ማረጋገጫና ምዝገባ አገልግሎት ወይም በቅርንጫፍ ጽ/ቤቶች የተረጋገጡ መሆን አለባቸው
በክልላዊ መንግስታት በተለያዩ ቦታዎች በሚገኙ ተርጓሚዎች የተተረጏሙ ሰነዶች፣ በክልሉ ፍትህ ቢሮ በቅድሚያ የተረጋገጡ መሆን አለባቸው
መታወቂያ/ፓስፖርት፣ በወኪል ከሆነ የውክልና ሥልጣን ማስረጃ

services.name: Authentication of Birth, Death, Marriage, Divorce, Single Status Certificates, and Adoption Documents
required_documents: For documents issued in Addis Ababa or Dire Dawa: Must first be verified by the respective city's Civil Registration and Residency Service Agency.
For documents issued by Regional States: Must first be verified by the region's Civil Registration and Residency Service Agency or another authorized regional body.
For documents issued abroad:
First, they must be verified by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (or an authorized body) of the country where they were issued.
Next, they must be verified by the Ethiopian (FDRE) Embassy/Mission covering that country, OR by that country's embassy in Addis Ababa (or the embassy covering Ethiopia).
For Marriage or Divorce Verification: Both husband and wife must appear in person to verify these certificates.
Identification: A valid ID or Passport (plus a legal Power of Attorney if applying through a representative).
services.fee_text: Domestic/Local Documents: Birth Certificate: 500 Birr Other Certificates (Marriage, Divorce, Death, etc.): 500 Birr Foreign Documents (All types): 650 Birr,

services.name: Authentication of Domestic (Local) Educational Credentials
required_documents: For credentials from public (government) universities and their colleges: Must first be verified by the registrar's office of the main university.
For degrees and higher qualifications from private (non-government) universities and colleges: Must first be verified by the Higher Education Relevance and Quality Agency.

For diplomas, lower certificates, and vocational/professional certificates (from both public and private schools): Must be verified by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Agency of the respective region or city administration (Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa).

For school certificates from primary or secondary schools under Regional States or the Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa City Administrations: Must first be verified by the respective region or city Education Bureau.
For Grade 10 or Grade 12 School Leaving Exam Certificates: Must first be verified by the Educational Assessment and Examinations Service (EAES).
Identification: A valid ID or Passport (along with a legal Power of Attorney document if applying through a representative).

services.name: Authentication of Medical Documents Issued by Health Institutions
required_documents: For medical records and related documents issued by facilities in Addis Ababa, Dire Dawa, or Regional States: Must first be verified by the respective city or regional Food and Drug Control Authority, or the local Health Bureau, as appropriate.
For medical check-ups and medical board decisions for traveling abroad for treatment: Must first be verified by the Ministry of Health.
Identification: A valid ID or Passport (along with a legal Power of Attorney document if applying through a representative).

services.name: Authentication of Driver's License
required_documents: For driver's licenses issued by the Addis Ababa or Dire Dawa City Administrations: Must first be verified by the city's Road Transport Bureau or a Sub-City Transport Office.
For driver's licenses issued by Regional States: Must first be verified by the respective regional Road Transport Bureau.
Identification: A valid ID or Passport (along with a legal Power of Attorney document if applying through a representative).

services.name: Fingerprint and Criminal Clearance Certificate Authentication
required_documents: Must be issued and verified by the Federal Police Crime and Forensic Investigation Bureau.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Authentication of Power of Attorney, Declaration, and Affidavit Documents
required_documents: If issued at various levels within the Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa City Administrations, they must first be authenticated by the respective City Administration's Documents Authentication and Registration Service (DARS).

If issued at the Zone or Woreda levels within National Regional States, they must first be authenticated by the Regional Justice Bureau or the Regional Documents Authentication and Registration Service.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Authentication of Business Licenses and Trade-Related Documents
required_documents: For the verification of business license registration and renewal documents issued by the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration, proof of current tax payment must be submitted beforehand.

If the documents relate to Import/Export trade, they must first be authenticated by the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration, the Ethiopian Chamber of Commerce and Sectoral Associations, or, if issued by Regional States or City Administrations (Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa), by the respective Regional or City Chamber of Commerce or Bureau of Trade.

If the documents concern health quarantine and related matters for export products, they must first be authenticated by the Ministry of Agriculture or its authorized branch offices. If issued at various levels within Regional Governments, they must first be authenticated by the Regional Bureau of Trade.
If issued by the Addis Ababa or Dire Dawa City Administrations, they must first be authenticated by the respective Administration's Bureau of Trade or Sub-City Trade Branch Offices.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Authentication of Investment Licenses and Investment-Related Documents
required_documents: If issued by the Federal Investment Commission, they must first be authenticated by the Commission.
If issued by the Addis Ababa or Dire Dawa City Administrations, they must first be authenticated by the respective City Administration's Investment Bureau.
If the documents are issued at various levels within Regional Governments, they must first be authenticated by the Regional Investment Bureau.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Authentication of Property Title Deeds / Land Holding Certificates (Authentication via Confirmation Letter) (Authentication is not stamped directly on the document)
required_documents: If issued by the Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa City Administrations or by a National Regional State, a certified True Copy of the title deed/map must first be verified by the respective City Administration or Regional Land Development and Administration Bureau.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Authentication of Property Title Deeds / Land Holding Certificates (Verification via Confirmation Letter) (Authentication is not stamped directly on the document)
required_documents: If issued by the Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa City Administrations or by a National Regional State, a certified True Copy of the title deed/map must first be verified by the respective City Administration or Regional Land Development and Administration Bureau.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Verification of Vehicle Registration Certificate (Libre) Service (Verification via Confirmation Letter) (Authentication is not stamped directly on the document)
required_documents: If issued at the federal level, it must be from the Ministry of Transport and Logistics. If issued by the Addis Ababa or Dire Dawa City Administrations or by a National Regional State, a certified True Copy of the registration certificate (Libre) must first be verified by the respective Ministry, City Administration, or Regional Driver and Vehicle Licensing Authority.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Verification of Hajj and Umrah Travel and Related Documents
required_documents: Must first be authenticated by the Supreme Council for Islamic Affairs.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Verification of "To Whom It May Concern" Documents
required_documents: If the documents originate from federal, regional, or city administrations, universities, or various offices and organizations, they must first be authenticated by the respective Federal Executive Agency or Regional Executive Bureau, as applicable.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Verification of Employment Contracts and Related Documents
required_documents: If the document originates from abroad, it must first be authenticated by that country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs or an authorized body. Following that, it must be pre-verified either by the FDRE (Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia) Mission located in or covering that country, or by that country's Embassy in Addis Ababa.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Verification of Any Other Types of Documents Issued by Various Institutions in Our Country
required_documents: If issued by a federal institution or organization, it must first be authenticated by the respective Federal Executive Agency. If it originates from a Regional State or the Addis Ababa/Dire Dawa City Administrations, it must first be authenticated by the respective Regional or City Administration Executive Bureau.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Verification of Any Other Types of Documents Issued by Various Institutions in Other Countries
required_documents: The document must first be authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the authorized body of the country where it originated. Following that, it must be pre-verified either by the FDRE (Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia) Mission located in or covering that country, or by that country's Embassy in Addis Ababa.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: Verification of Legally Documented Translations Submitted Alongside the Original Copy
required_documents: If the documents are translated by translators located in various areas of the Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa City Administrations, they must first be authenticated by the Documents Authentication and Registration Service (DARS) or its branch offices.
If the documents are translated by translators located in various areas of Regional States, they must first be authenticated by the Regional Justice Bureau.
ID Card/Passport; if processed through an agent, a legal Power of Attorney is required.

services.name: የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቁጥር (TIN) መስጠት
required_documents: *ለግለሰቦች:
የብሔራዊ መታወቂያ ካርድ ቁጥር (የቀበሌ መታወቂያ)
*ለፌዴራል መንግሥት መሥሪያ ቤቶች እና በፌዴራል መንግሥት ለተቋቋሙ የልማት ድርጅቶች:
የድርጅቱ መመስረቻ ሰነድ
የድርጅቱ ሥራ አስኪያጅ የሹመት ደብዳቤ
የሥራ አስኪያጁ የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቁጥር
የሥራ አስኪያጁ የኢትዮጵያ ወይም የሌላ አገር ፓስፖርት ወይም የቀበሌ መታወቂያ
ባለፉት ስድስት ወራት ውስጥ የተነሳ ፎቶግራፍ
*በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ለሚንቀሳቀስ ነዋሪ ያልሆነ ቋሚ ተቋም:
ከተመሰረተበት አገር የተሰጠ የምስክር ወረቀት
የቋሚ ተቋሙ በኢትዮጵያ ያለውን የሥራ አድራሻ የሚያሳይ ሰነድ
ባለፉት ስድስት ወራት ውስጥ የተነሳ የድርጅቱ ዋና ሥራ አስኪያጅ ፎቶግራፍ
የዋና ሥራ አስኪያጁ የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቁጥር
በወኪል አማካኝነት የሚቀርብ ከሆነ ሕጋዊ የውክልና ማስረጃ
*ለፌዴራል ከፍተኛ ትምህርት ተቋማት የውጭ አገር ተጠቃሚ ተማሪዎች:
የባዮሜትሪክ መለያ መረጃ መስጠት
የታደሰ የኢትዮጵያ ወይም የሌላ አገር ፓስፖርት ወይም የቀበሌ መታወቂያ ማቅረብ
በትምህርት ተቋሙ የተሰጠ የታደሰ የተማሪ መታወቂያ ካርድ ማቅረብ
*በመንግሥታት መካከል በሚደረግ ስምምነት ወይም በዋና መሥሪያ ቤት ስምምነት ለተቋቋሙ ድርጅቶች:
ድርጅቱን ወይም ዋና መሥሪያ ቤቱን ያቋቋመው የስምምነት ሰነድ ማቅረብ
የድርጅቱ ወይም የዋና መሥሪያ ቤቱ የሥራ ዳይሬክተር የሹመት ደብዳቤ ማቅረብ
የሥራ ዳይሬክተሩ የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቁጥር ማቅረብ
የሥራ ዳይሬክተሩ የኢትዮጵያ ወይም የሌላ አገር ፓስፖርት ወይም የቀበሌ መታወቂያ ማቅረብ
ባለፉት ስድስት ወራት ውስጥ የተነሳ ፎቶግራፍ ማቅረብ

services.name: የተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ (VAT) ምዝገባ
required_documents: የአገልግሎት መጠየቂያ ፎርም ሞልቶ ማቅረብ
የንግድ ዋና ምዝገባ የምስክር ወረቀት
የንግድ ፈቃድ የምስክር ወረቀት
ወቅታዊ የሆነ የቤት ኪራይ ውል(የአድረሻ ለውጥ፣ የስራ አስኪያጅ እና ሌሎች የምዝገባ መረጃዎች የተለወጠ ካለ ወቅታዊ መሆን)
የባንክ ሂሳብ ደብተር

services.name: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) Registration
required_documents: Biometric Authentication: Provision of physical identity verification (fingerprints) at the registry office.
1. For Managers | Shareholders | and Diaspora Applicants
Valid, renewed passport (Ethiopian or foreign) or a National Digital ID (Fayda).
For guardians of a minor who inherited a family business: A legal court judgment confirming legal guardianship.
Official letter of appointment for the General Manager.
2. For Business Partnerships and Companies
Approved Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association.
Valid Passport or National Digital ID (Fayda) of the General Manager.
A certified office rent contract/lease agreement or a valid property ownership title deed (Map).
2 recent passport-sized photographs taken within the last six months.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the General Manager.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of each shareholder/member.
If the applicant is a legal agent/representative: A valid, legally authenticated Power of Attorney. For a business in formation, a written authorization signed by all founding members.
If any shareholder is a foreign national: The original passport alongside a photocopy, plus a supporting document issued by the Investment Commission/Office.
3. For State-Owned Enterprises (Public Development Enterprises)
The Establishment Proclamation or Legal Regulation under which the enterprise was founded.
Official letter of appointment for the General Manager.
Valid Passport or National Digital ID (Fayda) of the General Manager.
2 recent passport-sized photographs of the General Manager taken within the last six months.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the General Manager.
If the applicant is an authorized representative: A valid legal Power of Attorney.
4. For Government Budgetary Institutions
The Establishment Proclamation or Legal Regulation under which the institution was founded.
An official letter of authorization designating the assigned representative.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the designated representative.
5. For Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs)
Approved Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association certified by the legally authorized government organ.
Official letter of appointment for the General Manager/Director.
Valid Passport or National Digital ID (Fayda) of the General Manager.
2 recent passport-sized photographs of the General Manager taken within the last six months.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the General Manager.
6. For International Organizations and Embassies
A valid Registration Certificate issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA).
An official letter of appointment and a valid, renewed passport of the Head of the Mission/Ambassador.
2 recent passport-sized photographs taken within the last six months.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the General Manager or Ambassador.
7. For Religious Institutions
A valid Registration Certificate issued by the competent government authority.
A legal Power of Attorney designating the authorized representative of the institution.
A recent passport-sized photograph of the Head or designated representative of the institution taken within the last six months.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the institution's Head.
8. For Non-Resident Entities with a Permanent Establishment in Ethiopia
The original Certificate of Incorporation/Registration issued in the country of origin.
Documentary proof certifying the physical workplace/business address of the non-resident permanent establishment in Ethiopia.
A recent passport-sized photograph of the General Manager taken within the last six months.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the General Manager.
If the applicant is an authorized representative: A valid legal Power of Attorney.
9. For Cost-Sharing Beneficiaries (Federal Higher Education Students)
Biometric Authentication: Provision of physical identity verification (fingerprints).
Valid, renewed passport (Ethiopian or foreign) or National Digital ID (Fayda).
A valid, renewed student identification card issued by the respective higher education institution.
10. For Organizations Established via Inter-Governmental or Office Establishment Agreements
The official bilateral or multilateral agreement under which the organization or office was established.
Official letter of appointment for the General Manager.
Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the General Manager.
Valid Passport (Ethiopian or foreign) or National Digital ID (Fayda) of the General Manager.
A recent passport-sized photograph taken within the last six months.

services.name: Value Added Tax (VAT) Registration
required_documents: A fully completed and signed VAT registration application form.
Principal Registration Certificate (Commercial Registration Certificate).
A valid Business License.

A current and valid office rent contract/lease agreement (or updated registration documents reflecting any changes to business address, general manager, or other essential corporate registry details).
Company Bank Passbook / Bank Statement.

services.name: የውክልና ሰነድ ማረጋገጥ
required_documents: ለግለሰብ
የውክልና ሰጪው ፋይዳ መታወቂያ
ፓስፖር/ት/ኢ/ዊ መታዉቂያ (በኢትዮጵያ የማይኖሩ የውጭ ዜጎች)
የጋብቻ ሁኔታ ማረጋገጫ
የውክልና ሰነድ (በሕጋዊ ተወካይ ከቀረበ)
የባለቤትነት ማረጋገጫ (ንብረት ከተጠቀሰ)
የሙያ ፈቃድ ቁጥር (ጠበቃ ከተወከለ)
የባንክ ሂሳብ ደብተር (የሂሳብ ቁጥር ከተጠቀሰ)
የልደት ማስረጃ ወይም የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ (ለአሳዳጊ/ሞግዚት)
ለቤተሰብ ውክልና፡ የልደት ማስረጃ፣ የጋብቻ ማስረጃ፣ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ
ለመንግስታዊና ለትርፍ ያልሆኑ ድርጅቶች
መተዳደሪያ ደንብ (Bylaws)
የምዝገባ ሰርተፍኬት
የውክልና ደብዳቤ
የተቋቋመበት ሕግ (ለመንግስት ተቋማት)
መታወቂያ

Construction Permit.

services.name: Investment Incentive Service: Requirements to Obtain Spare Parts (Online)
required_documents: Eligibility Window & Limit: The investor is allowed to import duty-free spare parts within five (5) years from the date they became eligible for incentives or from the date their business license was issued. The total value of these spare parts must not exceed 15% of the total value of the imported capital goods.
Key Requirement: The approved duty-free clearance letter that was previously issued for the main capital goods.

services.name: Investment Incentive Service: Requirements to Obtain a Vehicle (Online)
required_documents: Online Application: An application submitted through the Electronic Single Window (eSW) by the investor, general manager, or a legally authorized representative.

Investment Permit and a valid Business License.
Letter of Credit (L/C): If the vehicle is imported through a bank permit.
Proof of Foreign Funding/Investor Status: If the vehicle is imported under a Franco-Valuta scheme (importing using own foreign exchange from abroad).
For Staff Buses: Payroll records, pension contribution receipts, and income tax payment receipts (to prove the active status and number of employees requiring transport).
